sweeps.name: shape-and-ep
sweeps.narrative: EP should pay most at tp 8 and fade as dp grows, since wider dp already splits the batch and EP adds dispatch on top.

sweeps.name: batch-caps-vs-shape
sweeps.narrative: The sequence cap should bind well before the token cap on short chatbot prompts, and hardest on one wide instance.

sweeps.name: moe-dispatch
sweeps.narrative: DeepEP backends should lose to allgather/pplx at small dp and close the gap as dp widens, where the token cap admits them.

sweeps.name: eplb-vs-dispatch
sweeps.narrative: Redundant experts should help most at the widest dp, where an uneven expert load stalls the most ranks.

sweeps.name: graph-capture
sweeps.narrative: Full graph capture should beat PIECEWISE by a few percent at every shape, and NONE should roughly halve throughput.

sweeps.name: capture-size-vs-batch
sweeps.narrative: A small capture size should cost throughput only when max_num_seqs lets the batch grow past it.

sweeps.name: prefill-admission
sweeps.narrative: Chunking prefills below the 256-token median prompt should cut the ITL tail but cost throughput, most on one wide instance.

sweeps.name: routing
sweeps.narrative: With only two endpoints, routing should move throughput a few percent at most, slightly more when the batch cap binds.

objective: max output tok/s per GPU subject to the scenario's SLOs
